newsitem.title: EL SALVADOR: El Salvador expects record 96-97 sugar harvest.
newsitem.headline: El Salvador expects record 96-97 sugar harvest.

text.p: El Salvador expects to have a record sugar harvest of 385,000 tonnes from the 1996-1997 campaign up from the 325,000 tonnes in the last cycle, the Salvadoran Sugar Association said Thursday.
"It will be the best sugar production ever seen in the country," Mario Salaverria told Reuters, adding that expectations for increased mill yields were behind the record forecast.

Salavarria said the harvest (November-April) will be sold 65 percent on domestic markets, 10 percent will be exported to the United States and the remaining 25 percent traded on other world markets, including Kenya.
He said the expected record would come from 52,000 hectares of cane planted, slightly higher than the previous cycle.
